Why should you expand your clientele and practice beyond the national boundaries? 

Doesn’t that come only with years and years of experience?

How can you advise clients on laws of other countries when you aren’t qualified to practise in that country?

Why does enforcement matter? Isn’t it up to the litigators?

Well, there’s no time like now to expand your practice beyond the barriers of your country.

Consider this: the global legal market is approximately USD 800 billion. The US, one of the huge legal markets, is around USD 300 billion. As against this, back home in India, our legal industry is only USD 2 billion in size.

This creates a great opportunity to cater to international markets, rather than just focussing on India or your home country.
